doubts: Supplement pass: supplement quotes give the supplement's physical page (1-6). X1 now 5 ('All results are averaged over 5 random seeds'). Y11 now yes (ci): 95% confidence intervals are named for Tables 2-5, but the shaded bands of the main Figure 4 are still never defined, so Y2 stays no. Q3 stays no: Tables 6-8 and Appendix B give most settings, but the SAC learning rates are missing. Q4 stays no: SkewFit uses 'default hyperparameters from [61]' without listing them. Q7 yes: a separate evaluation set of 512 goal images, drawn from the same distribution, so Y8 no (the real-robot data tests only disentanglement, not RL). Y9 no: the number of weak labels and the labelled factors are data conditions, not method hyperparameters. X4 no: the paper reports which VAE latent size worked best for the baselines but does not describe how it was tuned. Y1: the goal distance is defined but not the point within the episode nor the evaluation points of the curves. Y4: neither text nor figure clearly shows a loss.
